contracts.action: Row click ignores clicks while text is selected (drag-select to copy a file name)
contracts.equivalent_path: The same row onClick handler that toggled via setFixing([finding.path], !fixing); the checkbox's own onChange path is unchanged.
contracts.before_after: Before: any non-input click on a selectable row toggled it, including the click that ends a drag-select. After: that click returns early when window.getSelection() has text. A plain click collapses any earlier selection on mousedown, so a later plain click still toggles. Clicks on the input are still filtered by the closest('input') check above it.
contracts.visible_effect: Dragging over a name to copy it leaves the checkbox, dimming, group count and Fix button label as they were. Plain clicks toggle as before.
contracts.failure_mode: No async call. window.getSelection() can return null, and the optional chain handles that by falling through to the toggle.

thread_replies.reply: Addressed. The row handler at reconcile-dialog.tsx:216 now returns early when window.getSelection() has text, so a drag-select over a name no longer toggles the row. The test at reconcile.test.tsx:368-374 mocks a selection, clicks the row, and checks the box keeps its state.
